name: Farroupilha (Brazil)
description: Divided by a descending diagonal red band into a green upper fly and a yellow lower hoist, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the municipal arms.
history: Farroupilha is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, settled by Italian immigrants. According to Flags of the World the colours stand for faith (green), strong-mindedness (red), commitment to work (yellow) and purity of mind (white); the arms, designed by Valter Spaldi, are prescribed by Municipal Law No. 655 of 20 December 1963.

features.role: green upper fly and yellow lower hoist
municipal arms with a mural crown, an Italian shield with a wavy bend, the Farroupilha shield and grapes
